meaning.en: Accessible charging bay: a charging point usable from a wheelchair (step-free, wider bay, reachable controls)
meaning.de: Barrierefreier Ladeplatz: ein Ladepunkt, der vom Rollstuhl aus nutzbar ist (stufenlos, breiter Stellplatz, erreichbare Bedienung)

meaning.en: Charging by app: start and pay a charging session with a smartphone app
meaning.de: Laden per App: Ladevorgang mit einer Smartphone-App starten und bezahlen

meaning.en: Battery charging: the vehicle battery is being charged
meaning.de: Akku lädt: die Fahrzeugbatterie wird geladen

meaning.en: Bidirectional charging: energy flows into and out of the vehicle (V2G, V2H)
meaning.de: Bidirektionales Laden: Energie fließt ins Fahrzeug und zurück (V2G, V2H)

meaning.en: Electric bike: e-bike, pedelec or electric cargo bike (light electric vehicle)
meaning.de: E-Bike: Pedelec, S-Pedelec oder E-Lastenrad (leichtes Elektrofahrzeug)

meaning.en: Electric bus: a battery electric bus or coach (vehicle class M2/M3)
meaning.de: E-Bus: batterieelektrischer Bus oder Reisebus (Fahrzeugklasse M2/M3)

meaning.en: Calibrated meter: the charging point bills energy with a meter that complies with calibration law (Eichrecht)
meaning.de: Geeichter Zähler: der Ladepunkt rechnet die Energie mit einem eichrechtskonformen Zähler ab

meaning.en: Electric car (battery electric vehicle)
meaning.de: E-Auto (batterieelektrisches Fahrzeug)

meaning.en: Electric car connected to a charging cable
meaning.de: E-Auto am Ladekabel (angeschlossen)

meaning.en: Card terminal: ad hoc payment by debit or credit card, contactless
meaning.de: Kartenterminal: Ad-hoc-Zahlung mit Debit- oder Kreditkarte, kontaktlos

meaning.en: Charging availability: how many charging points at a site are free or occupied
meaning.de: Belegung: wie viele Ladepunkte eines Standorts frei oder belegt sind

meaning.en: Charging or electricity in general (plain lightning bolt)
meaning.de: Laden oder Strom allgemein (einfacher Blitz)

meaning.en: Charging cable attached to the charge point (tethered cable with plug, no own cable needed)
meaning.de: Am Ladepunkt angeschlagenes Ladekabel (Kabel mit Stecker vorhanden, kein eigenes Kabel nötig)

meaning.en: Charging card: an RFID card that starts a charging session
meaning.de: Ladekarte: RFID-Karte, die einen Ladevorgang startet

meaning.en: Charging hub: a site with several charging points in one place (HPC hub, charging park)
meaning.de: Ladepark: ein Standort mit mehreren Ladepunkten an einem Ort (HPC-Hub)

meaning.en: Charging log: a record of charging sessions, for example a log book or receipt
meaning.de: Ladetagebuch: Aufzeichnung der Ladevorgänge, zum Beispiel Ladeprotokoll oder Beleg

meaning.en: Charge point operator (CPO): the company that runs a charging point
meaning.de: Ladepunktbetreiber (CPO): das Unternehmen, das einen Ladepunkt betreibt

meaning.en: Charging plug in general, seen from the side with its cable (no specific connector type)
meaning.de: Ladestecker allgemein, Seitenansicht mit Kabel (kein bestimmter Steckertyp)

meaning.en: Charging power level: the charging power shown on a scale (kW display, power filter)
meaning.de: Ladeleistung als Skala: die Ladeleistung auf einer Skala (kW-Anzeige, Leistungsfilter)

meaning.en: Charging session in progress: the vehicle is charging right now (live session)
meaning.de: Ladevorgang läuft: das Fahrzeug lädt gerade (laufende Sitzung)

meaning.en: Charging socket: the charging point has a socket outlet, bring your own cable (no tethered cable)
meaning.de: Ladepunkt mit Steckdose: Kabel mitbringen (kein fest angeschlagenes Kabel)

meaning.en: Charging station: a public or private charge point for electric vehicles
meaning.de: Ladesäule: öffentlicher oder privater Ladepunkt für Elektrofahrzeuge

meaning.en: Charging tariff: the price of charging, for example per kWh
meaning.de: Ladetarif: der Preis fürs Laden, zum Beispiel je kWh

meaning.en: Charging time: how long a charging session takes, or a time-based tariff
meaning.de: Ladedauer: wie lange ein Ladevorgang dauert, oder ein Zeittarif

meaning.en: Community verified: information reported or confirmed by drivers (for example a price, a free charger or a tip)
meaning.de: Von der Community bestätigt: von Fahrern gemeldete oder bestätigte Angabe (zum Beispiel ein Preis, kostenloses Laden oder ein Hinweis)

meaning.en: Alternating current (AC) charging
meaning.de: Laden mit Wechselstrom (AC)

meaning.en: Direct current (DC) charging
meaning.de: Laden mit Gleichstrom (DC)

meaning.en: Car dealer charging: a charging point at a car dealership, showroom or garage
meaning.de: Laden beim Autohaus: ein Ladepunkt beim Autohaus, im Showroom oder in der Werkstatt

meaning.en: Destination charging: charging while staying at a hotel, shop or restaurant
meaning.de: Laden am Ziel: laden während des Aufenthalts im Hotel, beim Einkaufen oder im Restaurant

meaning.en: Range: distance the vehicle can drive on its battery charge
meaning.de: Reichweite: Strecke, die das Fahrzeug mit der Akkuladung fahren kann

meaning.en: Fast charging: high charging power, typically DC fast or high-power charging
meaning.de: Schnellladen: hohe Ladeleistung, typischerweise DC-Schnellladen oder HPC

meaning.en: Free charging: charging at no cost to the driver
meaning.de: Kostenlos laden: Laden, das für den Fahrer nichts kostet

meaning.en: Fuel station charging: a charging point at a fuel or service station (under the canopy)
meaning.de: Laden an der Tankstelle: ein Ladepunkt an einer Tank- oder Raststätte (unter dem Tankstellendach)

meaning.en: Green power: electricity from renewable sources
meaning.de: Ökostrom: Strom aus erneuerbaren Quellen

meaning.en: Motorway charging: charging on or next to a motorway (service area, rest stop)
meaning.de: Laden an der Autobahn: Laden an oder neben der Autobahn (Raststätte, Rastplatz)

meaning.en: Home charging: charging the vehicle at home
meaning.de: Laden zu Hause: das Fahrzeug zu Hause laden

meaning.en: Idle fee: a fee for occupying the charging point after charging has finished
meaning.de: Blockiergebühr: Gebühr für das Belegen des Ladepunkts nach dem Ende des Ladevorgangs

meaning.en: Map marker for an AC charging point
meaning.de: Kartenmarker für einen AC-Ladepunkt

meaning.en: Map marker: the charging point is available
meaning.de: Kartenmarker: der Ladepunkt ist frei

meaning.en: Map marker for a charging point
meaning.de: Kartenmarker für einen Ladepunkt

meaning.en: Map marker for a cluster of charging points; the app draws the count in the head
meaning.de: Kartenmarker für mehrere zusammengefasste Ladepunkte; die App schreibt die Anzahl in den Kopf

meaning.en: Map marker for a DC charging point
meaning.de: Kartenmarker für einen DC-Ladepunkt

meaning.en: Map marker: the charging point reports an error and cannot charge
meaning.de: Kartenmarker: der Ladepunkt meldet einen Fehler und kann nicht laden

meaning.en: Map marker: the charging point is occupied
meaning.de: Kartenmarker: der Ladepunkt ist belegt

meaning.en: Map marker: the charging point is out of service
meaning.de: Kartenmarker: der Ladepunkt ist außer Betrieb

meaning.en: Map marker: drivers are queuing for the charging point, expect a wait
meaning.de: Kartenmarker: am Ladepunkt warten Fahrer in einer Warteschlange, mit Wartezeit rechnen

meaning.en: Map marker: the charging point is reserved for a booking
meaning.de: Kartenmarker: der Ladepunkt ist für eine Buchung reserviert

meaning.en: Map marker: the status of the charging point is unknown
meaning.de: Kartenmarker: der Status des Ladepunkts ist unbekannt

meaning.en: Electric motorcycle or electric scooter (vehicle class L, for example L1e and L3e)
meaning.de: E-Motorrad oder E-Roller (Fahrzeugklasse L, zum Beispiel L1e und L3e)

meaning.en: Charging parking: a parking space where electric vehicles can charge
meaning.de: Parken mit Laden: Parkplatz, auf dem Elektrofahrzeuge laden können

meaning.en: Plug & Charge: the vehicle authorises the charging session automatically when it is plugged in (ISO 15118)
meaning.de: Plug & Charge: das Fahrzeug schaltet den Ladevorgang beim Einstecken automatisch frei (ISO 15118)

meaning.en: CCS Combo 1 connector (IEC 62196-3 configuration EE, SAE J1772 Type 1 with two DC contacts; North America), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: CCS-Combo-1-Stecker (IEC 62196-3 Konfiguration EE, SAE-J1772-Typ-1 mit zwei DC-Kontakten; Nordamerika), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.norm: IEC 62196-3 configuration EE (CCS Combo 1) / SAE J1772 DC
standard.source: IEC 62196-3 and SAE J1772 themselves not consulted. Layout checked against the public drawing "File:J1772 (CCS1).svg" on Wikimedia Commons by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0), retrieved 2026-11-03, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:J1772_(CCS1).svg: "view facing the end of the plug", i.e. the face of the cable connector, drawn approximately to scale (10 px = 1 mm). It shows the round Type 1 face with the same five contacts as the author's "File:J1772 connector.svg" (L1 and N large at the top left and right, PP and CP small at the lower left and right, PE large at the bottom centre; (±0.38, −0.33) R, (±0.52, +0.27) R and (0, +0.52) R from the face centre), and below it a separate stadium-shaped DC part, about 1.2 times as wide as the face diameter, with DC+ (left) and DC− (right) concentric with its round ends. The icon shows the vehicle inlet seen from the front, which is the mirror image (N top left, L1 top right, CP lower left, PP lower right, DC− left, DC+ right); because the contacts of each pair have the same size, the mirrored face looks the same. Drawn: the Type 1 face as a circle R 6 (latch, keying tab and the neck between the two parts omitted, too fine) with the drawing's contact positions scaled to R 6; L1, N and PE as solid discs (two-arc paths r 0.75, as the CCS2 power contacts), because rings r 1.0 would leave only 1.98 and 1.88 to the face outline; PP and CP as dots. The DC part is the plug-ccs2 DC part unchanged (13.3 wide, 1.11 times the face diameter); the gap between face and DC part is 2.0 instead of the drawing's 0.46 R so that both parts fit the live area.

meaning.en: CCS Combo 2 connector (IEC 62196-3, Type 2 with two DC contacts), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: CCS-Combo-2-Stecker (IEC 62196-3, Typ 2 mit zwei DC-Kontakten), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: IEC 62196-3 itself not consulted (paywalled). Layout checked against two public drawings on Wikimedia Commons, retrieved 2026-10-21: "File:IEC 62196 Type 2 (M, DC, CCS Combo 2).svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; male CCS Combo 2 face: Type 2 part with 7 contacts on top, separate stadium-shaped DC part below with DC+ and DC- concentric with its round ends), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:IEC_62196_Type_2_(M,_DC,_CCS_Combo_2).svg, and "File:Combo-ccs-eu.svg" by GreatDrok (CC BY-SA 4.0; Type 2 CCS (Europe) connector: same arrangement, DC part about as wide as the Type 2 part), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Combo-ccs-eu.svg. The Type 2 part follows the plug-type-2 geometry (row ratios 0.70 and 0.869 of the pitch, flat top at 0.778 R), scaled to R 6.65; contacts are drawn smaller than in the drawings so the strokes do not merge.

meaning.en: CHAdeMO DC connector (IEC 62196-3 configuration AA, JEVS G105), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: CHAdeMO-DC-Stecker (IEC 62196-3 Konfiguration AA, JEVS G105), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: IEC 62196-3 / JEVS G105 not consulted; layout checked against public drawings on Wikimedia Commons, retrieved 2026-11-01: "File:CHAdeMO connector.svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; connector face with 10 contacts: DC+ and DC- left and right on the centre line at 0.46 R, two round signal bosses above and below at 0.57 R, each with four signal contacts in a diamond, pitch 0.18 R from the boss centre), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:CHAdeMO_connector.svg, and "File:CHAdeMO socket.svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; socket face with the same arrangement: DC at 0.45 R, signal bosses at 0.55 R, signal contacts at 0.20 R from the boss centre), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:CHAdeMO_socket.svg. Drawn: outline, both DC contacts, and per signal boss the horizontal pair at the boss centre (upper boss: the two side contacts, labelled N/C and SS1 in the connector drawing; lower boss: C-L and C-H). Omitted: the upper and lower contact of each boss (FG, DCP, PP, SS2), the boss rims and the keyway, because they would merge at 16 px. Left and right are not distinguished (DC+ and DC- look alike).

meaning.en: GB/T DC connector (GB/T 20234.3, China; DC fast charging with the contacts DC+, DC−, PE, S+, S−, CC1, CC2, A+, A−), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: GB/T-DC-Stecker (GB/T 20234.3, China; DC-Schnellladen mit den Kontakten DC+, DC−, PE, S+, S−, CC1, CC2, A+, A−), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: GB/T 20234.3 itself not consulted. Layout checked against the public drawing "File:GBT 20234 (DC).svg" on Wikimedia Commons by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0), retrieved 2026-11-03, https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/28/GBT_20234_%28DC%29.svg (file page https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:GBT_20234_(DC).svg): "GBT-20234.3 electric vehicle connector pinout for DC charging", dimensions taken from UNECE EVE-07-14e and the pinout from the Amphenol GB/T catalogue (as the file page states; only the ratios to the outline radius were used, so the drawing's scale does not matter). It shows the connector face: a circle with a flat top 0.876 R above the centre, a top row S+, CC2, S− at (−0.356, 0, +0.356) R across and 0.622 R above the centre, CC1 0.267 R above the centre, the two large power contacts DC+ (left) and DC− (right) at (±0.504, +0.036) R with r 0.385 R, PE (r 0.237 R) 0.622 R below the centre between A+ (left) and A− (right) at ±0.422 R. The icon shows the vehicle inlet seen from the front, which is the mirror image (S− top left, S+ top right, DC− left, DC+ right, A− lower left, A+ lower right); the layout is mirror-symmetric, so only the labels swap and the face looks the same. Drawn: outline circle R 9 around (12, 12) with the flat top at y 4.25 (0.861 R, on the quarter grid; the drawing has 0.876 R), without fillets at the ends of the flat edge, because fillets would run into the top row (sharp-corner). Contact positions are the drawing's scaled to R 9 (the drawing's R is 337.5 px): S−, CC2, S+ dots at (8.8, 6.4), (12, 6.4), (15.2, 6.4); CC1 dot at (12, 9.6); A−, A+ dots at (8.2, 17.6), (15.8, 17.6). Deviations from the drawing, for the 2.0 connector minimum: DC− and DC+ rings r 2.4 instead of r 3.47 at (7.5, 12.25) and (16.5, 12.25) (drawing (±4.53, +0.32) from the centre); PE ring r 1.5 instead of r 2.13, moved up 0.35 to (12, 17.25); the seven small contacts as dots instead of rings r 1.33.

meaning.en: Plug-in hybrid (PHEV): a vehicle that charges from the grid and also runs on fuel
meaning.de: Plug-in-Hybrid (PHEV): ein Fahrzeug, das am Stromnetz lädt und zusätzlich mit Kraftstoff fährt

meaning.en: MCS connector (Megawatt Charging System, SAE J3271 / IEC 63379; DC charging for trucks and buses with the contacts DC+, DC−, PE and four communication and detection contacts), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: MCS-Stecker (Megawatt Charging System, SAE J3271 / IEC 63379; DC-Laden für Lkw und Busse mit den Kontakten DC+, DC−, PE und vier Kommunikations- und Erkennungskontakten), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: SAE J3271 (2025) and IEC 63379 (2026) themselves not consulted; the official dimension drawing is in IEC 63379 (paywalled). Layout taken from the public drawing "File:MCS v3.2.svg" on Wikimedia Commons by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0), retrieved 2026-11-03, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MCS_v3.2.svg: "Speculative diagram of Megawatt Charging System, version 3.2", "Scale is 10px = 1 mm", dimensions "scaled and assumed from" an edited sketch posted in April 2022 (EPRI public download, as the file page states); the connector face, 130 mm wide. It shows a triangle with the tip down, its outline the hull of two upper corner circles (r 35 mm) concentric with the two DC contacts and a tip circle (r 24.5 mm) concentric with PE; two DC contacts (sleeve r 22.5 mm, pin r 9.5 mm) in the upper corners; PE (r 15 mm) at the bottom; four C contacts between them: a middle pair 8 mm apart in a shared stadium-shaped insulator and an outer pair lower left and right. Checked on 2026-11-03 against a second public figure, the CharIN pin assignment photo in EV Engineering Online, "Why cables and connectors are engineering challenges in megawatt EV charging" (A. Etengoff, 2026-06-17, Figure 2, "Image: CharIN"), https://www.evengineeringonline.com/why-cables-and-connectors-are-engineering-challenges-in-megawatt-ev-charging/: the face of the cable connector with the same contact count and the same basic arrangement (triangle tip down, DC+ top left and DC− top right, the communication pair PHY2, PHY1 side by side in one insulator in the middle, CE lower left and ID lower right, PE at the bottom); it differs only in detail (the middle pair sits higher, between the DC contacts). The seven pin names DC+, DC−, PE, PHY1, PHY2, CP, PP are given in NREL/TP-5400-89238 (2024), https://docs.nrel.gov/docs/fy24osti/89238.pdf (the report itself could not be retrieved on 2026-11-03, so its figures were not compared), and the arrangement matches Wikipedia "Megawatt Charging System". The icon shows the vehicle inlet seen from the front, the mirror image of the connector face; the layout is mirror-symmetric, so only the labels swap (DC− left, DC+ right). Drawn, scaled 1 mm = 0.146 units: outline as the hull of corner circles r 5.12 around (7.62, 8.72) and (16.38, 8.72) and a tip circle r 3.58 around (12, 16.84), joined by their outer tangents; DC rings r 2.5 in the corner circle centres (between the drawing's sleeve r 3.29 and pin r 1.39); PE ring r 1.5 at (12, 16.84) (drawing r 2.19, reduced for 2.08 to the tip circle); the outer C pair as dots at (8.78, 14.3) and (15.22, 14.3); the middle C pair as dots at (10.75, 12.8) and (13.25, 12.8), spread from the drawing's 1.17 to 2.5 apart, without the stadium around them (too fine).

meaning.en: NACS connector (SAE J3400, North American Charging Standard; AC and DC through the same two power contacts), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: NACS-Stecker (SAE J3400, North American Charging Standard; AC und DC über dieselben zwei Leistungskontakte), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: SAE J3400 itself not consulted. Layout checked against two public drawings, retrieved 2026-11-03: (1) Tesla, "North American Charging Standard Technical Specification" TS-0023666 (2022), section 5.1.1.2 "Inlet - 1,000V and 500V Configuration" (page 12), the vehicle inlet seen from the front, published openly by Tesla (no licence stated; only the geometry was checked, nothing copied) and since withdrawn in favour of SAE J3400; archived copy https://web.archive.org/web/20221217074652/https://tesla-cdn.thron.com/static/HXVNIC_North_American_Charging_Standard_Technical_Specification_TS-0023666_HFTPKZ.pdf. It shows a face wider at the top, with an arched top edge, rounded top corners, nearly straight sides and a rounded bottom (about 18 : 15.7), HV+ (top left) and HV− (top right) as two large contacts side by side, and below them a row of Control Pilot (lower left), Ground (bottom centre, slightly higher, in a keying tab) and Proximity Pilot (lower right); the Ground pin is smaller than the HV pins and larger than the pilot pins. (2) Wikimedia Commons "File:NACS pinout annotated.svg" by RickyCourtney (CC BY-SA 4.0), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NACS_pinout_annotated.svg: "view facing the end of the plug" (cable connector face): the same outline and the mirrored arrangement (DC−/L2 and DC+/L1 at the top, PP, G and CP in one row below, G larger than PP and CP). Positions follow the Tesla inlet figure scaled to a width of 18: HV contacts at (12 ± 4.85, 9.2), pilot contacts at (12 ± 3.75, 16.4), Ground at (12, 16.1). Drawn: the face outline (latch slot, keying tab and the inner housing pockets omitted, too fine), HV+ and HV− as rings r 1.5, Ground as a ring r 1.25, CP and PP as dots, so the three contact sizes of the drawings keep their order.

meaning.en: Schuko socket (CEE 7/3, DIN 49440, household AC), shown as the socket face seen from the front
meaning.de: Schuko-Steckdose (CEE 7/3, DIN 49440, Haushalt, AC), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn

standard.source: CEE 7/3 and DIN 49440 not consulted; layout checked against a public drawing on Wikimedia Commons, retrieved 2026-11-01: "File:Type F Socket.svg" by Aeroid (public domain; socket face: round recess 39 mm, two contact holes on the horizontal centre line 19 mm apart, earthing clips at the top and bottom of the recess), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Type_F_Socket.svg. Hole spacing follows that drawing (19/39 = 0.49 of the recess diameter); the holes are drawn as solid discs of diameter 2.5 (two-arc paths r 0.5, design guide section 2; the drawing's 5 mm holes scale to about 2.3) and the earthing clips as short horizontal strokes just inside the rim, not touching it, so they stay separate at 16 px. Socket face exception (design guide section 5): Schuko has no vehicle inlet.

meaning.en: Type 1 AC connector (SAE J1772, IEC 62196-2 Type 1; North America, Japan), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: Typ-1-AC-Stecker (SAE J1772, IEC 62196-2 Typ 1; Nordamerika, Japan), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: SAE J1772 and IEC 62196-2 themselves not consulted. Layout checked against three public drawings on Wikimedia Commons, retrieved 2026-11-02: "File:J1772 connector.svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; "view facing the plug end", i.e. the face of the cable connector, drawn approximately to scale, 10 px = 1 mm: round face, L1 and N large at the top left and right, PP and CP small at the lower left and right, PE large at the bottom centre; relative to the face radius R the contacts sit at (±0.38, −0.33) R, (±0.52, +0.27) R and (0, +0.52) R), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:J1772_connector.svg; "File:SAE J1772 Type 1.png" (Schneider Electric, CC BY 3.0; connector face with latch at the top, same arrangement: two large contacts at the top, two small ones at the sides, one large at the bottom centre), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:SAE_J1772_Type_1.png; and "File:Type1 J1772.svg" by GreatDrok (CC BY-SA 4.0; unlabelled, same arrangement), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Type1_J1772.svg. The Mliu92 drawing shows the connector face; the other two show the same arrangement; the icon shows the vehicle inlet seen from the front, which is its mirror image (N top left, L1 top right, CP lower left, PP lower right). Because L1 and N have the same size, and PP and CP too, the mirrored face looks the same. Contact positions are the Mliu92 positions scaled to R 9. Drawn: the face outline (latch and keying tab omitted, too fine), L1, N and PE as rings r 1.5, PP and CP as dots (the drawing's 4.5 mm signal pins against 6 mm power pins; plain dots keep the two sizes apart at 16 px).

meaning.en: Type 2 connector (IEC 62196-2, "Mennekes"), shown as the vehicle inlet face; the GB/T 20234.2 AC inlet (China) has the same face
meaning.de: Typ-2-Stecker (IEC 62196-2, „Mennekes“), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht; die GB/T-20234.2-AC-Buchse (China) hat dieselbe Steckfläche

standard.source: IEC 62196-2 itself not consulted (paywalled). Contact layout checked against two public drawings: Wikimedia Commons "File:Stecker-Typ 2 Belegung.svg" (public domain; Type 2 plug "bei Sicht auf die Steckkontakte", male contact face: top PP, CP; middle L1, PE, N; bottom L2, L3), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Stecker-Typ_2_Belegung.svg, and "File:IEC 62196-2 Type 2 (plug).svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; end view of the female connector: top CP, PP; middle N, PE, L1; bottom L3, L2, i.e. the mirror image), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:IEC_62196-2_Type_2_(plug).svg. Both retrieved 2026-10-21. The icon shows the male vehicle inlet seen from the front, which matches the male contact face. GB/T 20234.2 AC (not consulted itself) has the same face; checked on 2026-11-02 against Wikimedia Commons "File:GBT 20234 (AC).svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; connector face, the same geometry as the same author's Type 2 drawing, labels CC, CP / L1, PE, N / L2, L3), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:GBT_20234_(AC).svg, and Amphenol PCD Shenzhen, catalogue "Excel|Mate CC electric car charging coupler", page 5 "Insert arrangement" (vehicle inlet: flat side on top, rows CP, CC / N, PE, L1 / L3, L2), https://www.amphenol.co.jp/military/catalog/GBT.pdf; both show the Type 2 geometry.

meaning.en: Power in kilowatts (kW), for example the charging power of a charge point
meaning.de: Leistung in Kilowatt (kW), zum Beispiel die Ladeleistung eines Ladepunkts

meaning.en: Power outage: no grid power at the site, the charging point has no electricity
meaning.de: Stromausfall: kein Netzstrom am Standort, der Ladepunkt ist ohne Strom

meaning.en: QR code charging: start or pay for a charging session ad hoc by scanning the QR code at the charging point
meaning.de: Laden per QR-Code: einen Ladevorgang ad hoc über den QR-Code am Ladepunkt freischalten oder bezahlen

meaning.en: Report a fault: tell the operator that a charging point has an electrical or technical problem
meaning.de: Störung melden: dem Betreiber ein elektrisches oder technisches Problem an einem Ladepunkt melden

meaning.en: Restricted access: the charging point is not open to everyone (private, customers only, company vehicles only, behind a barrier)
meaning.de: Zugang eingeschränkt: der Ladepunkt ist nicht für alle zugänglich (privat, nur für Kunden, nur Firmenfahrzeuge, hinter einer Schranke)

meaning.en: Roaming: charging with a contract from another provider
meaning.de: Roaming: Laden mit dem Vertrag eines anderen Anbieters

meaning.en: Route to the charger: navigation to a charging point
meaning.de: Route zur Ladesäule: Navigation zu einem Ladepunkt

meaning.en: Charging while shopping: a charging point at a supermarket, shopping centre or retail car park
meaning.de: Laden beim Einkaufen: ein Ladepunkt am Supermarkt, Einkaufszentrum oder Kundenparkplatz

meaning.en: Solar charging: charging with power from photovoltaics (PV surplus)
meaning.de: Solarladen: Laden mit Strom aus Photovoltaik (PV-Überschuss)

meaning.en: Station uptime: the operating status of a charging point over time, its reliability (for example availability over the last 30 days)
meaning.de: Betriebsstatus über die Zeit: Zuverlässigkeit eines Ladepunkts (zum Beispiel Verfügbarkeit der letzten 30 Tage)

meaning.en: Available: the charge point is free and ready to charge
meaning.de: Frei: der Ladepunkt ist frei und betriebsbereit

meaning.en: Faulted: the station reports an error and cannot charge
meaning.de: Defekt: die Station meldet einen Fehler und kann nicht laden

meaning.en: Occupied: the charge point is in use by another vehicle
meaning.de: Belegt: der Ladepunkt wird gerade von einem anderen Fahrzeug genutzt

meaning.en: Out of service: taken out of service by the operator (for example maintenance or closure), not an error report
meaning.de: Außer Betrieb: vom Betreiber außer Betrieb genommen (z. B. Wartung oder Schließung), keine Fehlermeldung

meaning.en: Queue: cars are queuing at this station; you would have to wait
meaning.de: Warteschlange: an dieser Station warten bereits Autos; du müsstest warten

meaning.en: Reserved: the charge point is reserved for a booking
meaning.de: Reserviert: der Ladepunkt ist für eine Buchung reserviert

meaning.en: Unknown: no current status is available for the charge point
meaning.de: Unbekannt: für den Ladepunkt liegt kein aktueller Status vor

meaning.en: Street light charging: a charging point built into a street light (kerbside charging)
meaning.de: Laternenladen: ein Ladepunkt in einer Straßenlaterne (Laden am Straßenrand)

meaning.en: Electric truck: a battery electric goods vehicle (vehicle class N)
meaning.de: E-Lkw: batterieelektrisches Nutzfahrzeug (Fahrzeugklasse N)

meaning.en: Wallbox: a wall-mounted home charger for electric vehicles
meaning.de: Wallbox: an der Wand montierte Ladestation für Elektrofahrzeuge (Heimladen)
